title: TelegramGuard: an iLang-driven guardian bot for Telegram groups
description: A self-hostable Telegram bot that keeps a group clean and answers its members. Moderation, vision and chat behaviour are defined as iLang prompt specifications rather than prose, so the rules are readable and editable without touching the code. It runs against any OpenAI-compatible model, ships as a Docker image, needs two secrets to deploy, and is also available as a hosted bot. Readme in six languages.
